html:
G'oya

Masala ikki qismdan iborat. Avval har bir emaildan kichik harfli domenni ajratib, domenlar bo'yicha foydalanuvchilarni sanaymiz. Keyin eng katta sonni topib, aynan shu songa ega barcha domenlarni olamiz. Ikkinchi qism "eng ko'p" masalalarining odatiy shakli: g'olib bitta bo'lmasligi mumkin.

Yechim

WITH d AS (
  SELECT LOWER(SUBSTR(email, LENGTH(RTRIM(email, REPLACE(email, '@', ''))) + 1)) AS domain
  FROM users
  WHERE email IS NOT NULL
), c AS (
  SELECT domain, COUNT(*) AS user_count
  FROM d
  GROUP BY domain
)
SELECT domain, user_count
FROM c
WHERE user_count = (SELECT MAX(user_count) FROM c)

Domen @ dan keyin boshlanadi. Uning o'rnini PostgreSQL'da STRPOS(email, '@'), SQLite'da INSTR(email, '@') topadi. Yuqoridagi RTRIM usuli ikkala bazada ishlaydi: o'ng chetdan @ bo'lmagan belgilar kesiladi, ali@gmail.com dan ali@ qoladi va domen 5-belgidan boshlanadi.

c CTE'si ikki marta ishlatiladi: bir marta eng katta sonni topish uchun, bir marta shu songa teng qatorlarni olish uchun. Namunada gmail.com va mail.ru uchtadan foydalanuvchi bilan teng chiqadi va ikkalasi ham natijada bo'ladi. Malika@GMAIL.com va Jasur@Mail.Ru LOWER tufayli o'z guruhlariga qo'shildi.

Tuzoqlar

ORDER BY ... LIMIT 1 teng domenlardan faqat bittasini qaytaradi. Namunada mail.ru yoki gmail.com dan biri tushib qoladi, qaysi biri ekani esa bazaga bog'liq:

Noto'g'riSELECT LOWER(SUBSTR(email, LENGTH(RTRIM(email, REPLACE(email, '@', ''))) + 1)) AS domain,
       COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM users
WHERE email IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 1

WHERE email IS NOT NULL siz emaili yo'q foydalanuvchilar NULL domenli guruh bo'ladi. Ular ko'p bo'lsa, natijada eng mashhur "domen" sifatida NULL chiqadi.

LOWER faqat SELECT da emas, guruhlashdan oldin kerak. Bu yerda u d ichida, shuning uchun GROUP BY domain allaqachon kichik harfli qiymatlar bo'yicha ishlaydi.

Boshqa yo'l

PostgreSQL'da RANK() bilan ham bo'ladi. Oyna funksiyasi GROUP BY dan keyin ishlaydi, shuning uchun COUNT(*) bo'yicha tartiblash mumkin. Teng domenlar bir xil o'rin oladi va r = 1 ularning hammasini qoldiradi:

Faqat PostgreSQLSELECT domain, user_count
FROM (
  SELECT LOWER(SPLIT_PART(email, '@', 2)) AS domain,
         COUNT(*) AS user_count,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS r
  FROM users
  WHERE email IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
) t
WHERE r = 1
